'''Cai Ronggen''' ({{zh|s=蔡荣根}}; born September 1964) is a theoretical physicist and an [[academician]] of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] as well as the World Academy of Sciences for the Advancement of Science in Developing Countries. He is currently the President of [[Ningbo University]] and previously served as the Director and Party Secretary of the Institute of Theoretical Physics at the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].

==Biography==
Cai was born in [[Hangzhou|Hangzhou, Zhejiang]] in September 1964. After the resumption of the [[Gaokao|college entrance examination]], he was accepted to [[Hangzhou Normal University]], where he majored in [[physics]]. He earned his master's degree from [[Sichuan University]] in 1987 and his doctorate from [[Fudan University]] in 1995.

In July 1995, he joined the Institute of Theoretical Physics at the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) as a researcher. Cai's research has included cosmology and theories of [[dark energy]], including work related to holographic dark energy, a framework connecting dark-energy models with the holographic principle.<ref>{{Cite journal |date=2017-06-16 |title=Holographic dark energy |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0370157317301564 |journal=Physics Reports |language=en-US |volume=696 |doi=10.1016/j.phy |issn=0370-1573 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240206121601/https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0370157317301564 |archive-date=2024-02-06}}</ref> Two years later, he became a researcher at the Center for Theoretical Physics at [[Seoul National University]]. In September 1999, he moved to the Department of Physics at [[Osaka University]] as a researcher.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://phys.fudan.edu.cn/e5/e6/c10031a124390/page.htm |script-title=zh:热烈祝贺张东辉、蔡荣根系友当选中国科学院院士 |work=Fudan University |date=28 November 2017 |access-date=21 November 2019 |language=zh}}</ref> 

In 2017, Cai was elected an academician at CAS.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://casad.cas.cn/tzgg_124342/201711/t20171127_4682986.html |script-title=zh:关于公布2017年中国科学院院士增选当选院士名单的公告 |work=cas.cn |date=28 November 2017 |access-date=21 November 2019 |language=zh}}</ref> In January 2018, he became a member of the 13th National Committee of the [[Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference]].

==Award==
* 2011 Second Prize of National Natural Science Award
